problem.text: Job.receive_logits repeated three invariant checks at each sampling step: matching logit rows to sequences, completed prefill, and live sequences.

reasoning.text: Removing these checks plausibly reduces Python-side sampling overhead, trading local diagnostics for reliance on the generator's preparation. No speedup is established.

impact.text: The change comments out assertions only; token constraints, sampler arguments and result handling remain unchanged.

source_notes.text: The root generation entry was read. It describes the scheduling invariants and records an optional-output failure in receive_logits.

PR #30, “fix: don't add min_p and top_p samplers to stack if falsy,” concerns sampler parameter assertions. Issue #12, “Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct | ValueError: Unsupported type in stop_conditions,” concerns job construction and prompt mode. Their relationship to this task is only an inferred topical overlap—assertions/sampling and job.py respectively—not evidence that this change fixes either report.

limitations: No generation, GPU execution or performance benchmark was run. The scalar check exercises optional-return control flow only.

The inspected repository caller preserves readiness and row mapping under its normal model-output contract; arbitrary external calls, custom sampler side effects and malformed model outputs were not validated.

claims.text: The removed prefill assertion required every sequence's KV position to equal its token length minus one: the final input token remains for decoding. The other assertions rejected mismatched batch rows and any sequence marked non-live. No replacement checks are added inside receive_logits.

Whole-tree search finds Generator.iterate_gen as the sole active direct caller, plus a commented-out threaded caller. iterate_gen excludes unfinished-prefill jobs, builds logit boundaries from their input sequences, skips empty intervals, and passes each job's rows one token position at a time. receive_sample appends a token and advances KV position together, preserving the readiness equality during ordinary decoding.

Sequence initializes live=True; the generator-directory search finds no other live-field use besides the removed assertion. Thus no inspected normal caller establishes a false-live path. The scheduling checks and row construction remain, but malformed direct calls lose immediate assertion diagnostics.
The inherited optional-output failure remains: the task does not replace the pass branches that leave requested probability/top-token locals undefined.

findings.description: The touched function retains an inherited failure when optional sampling outputs are requested.
findings.trigger: A job reaches receive_logits with return_probs=True or return_top_tokens>0 and its sampler returns normally.
findings.expected_behavior: Return the requested probability or top-token values for the caller to pass to receive_sample.
findings.actual_behavior: The enabled branches execute pass, leaving next_prob or next_k_tokens/next_k_probs unassigned; constructing the return tuple raises UnboundLocalError. The sole active repository caller, Generator.iterate_gen, directly unpacks this tuple.

verification.description: Compared parent implementation, task diff and the active caller; the defective branches are carried over unchanged.
A scalar transcription returned normally with both options disabled and raised UnboundLocalError for each enabled option.
verification.limits: Models Python conditional assignments only, not repository execution or tensor sampling.

annotation.summary: Comments out three per-sample invariant assertions, relying on existing generator preparation. Performance is unmeasured; the inherited optional-output failure remains.
